sentences.text: If classified as a rebbachisaurid, a group of sauropod dinosaurs, Histriasaurus would be one of the oldest known members of that lineage.
The specific name H. boscarollii honors the discoverer of the fossil site, Darío Boscarolli.
The holotype specimen WN V-6 was found in a bonebed off the coast of Bale, Croatia, by Dario Boscarolli in the 1980s.
Histriasaurus was described in 1998 by Dalla Vecchia.
Histriasaurus coexisted with various indeterminate dinosaurs including a camarasaurid, a titanosauriform, a somphospondylian, and a theropod.
Histriasaurus lived during the Early Cretaceous, from the Hauterivian to Barremian stages, approximately 135 to 125 million years ago.
Some authors consider Histriasaurus a dubious taxon, while others support its original classification.
